_meta.description: Saved replies (messaging-saved-replies-and-resend, D2). A short text the team writes once and an agent picks wherever they answer a client: the Send message dialog (sms, whatsapp), the answer to the customer on a ticket (portal) and the Write email dialog (email). Shared by the team; there are no personal replies in this change. The picker fills {{client.name}}, {{contact.name}}, {{ticket.title}} and {{agent.name}} in the browser and leaves an unknown placeholder as written. No controller: the store reads and writes these through OpenRegister (ADR-022).

savedReply.title: Saved reply
savedReply.summary: A reply the team writes once and agents insert when they answer a client
savedReply.description: A saved reply with a title, a text and the channels it fits. Agents pick it from a list when they answer and can still change the text before sending.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name agents look for in the list, for example Opening hours.

body.title: Text
body.description: The text that goes into the message. You can use {{client.name}}, {{contact.name}}, {{ticket.title}} and {{agent.name}}.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where agents can pick this reply.

language.title: Language
language.description: Shown first to clients who asked to be written to in this language. Leave empty for every language.

active.title: Active
active.description: Switch off to hide this reply from the list without removing it.
